CFML Language Reference: Functions

StructFindValue

Searches a structure, and every structure and array nested inside it, for keys whose simple value equals value. The comparison ignores case.

Category

Structure functions

Syntax

StructFindValue(top, value [, scope])

Parameters

top
The structure to search.
value
The value to look for.
scope
"one" (the default) stops at the first match; "all" returns every match.

Returns

An array of structures, one per match, each with the keys Key (the name of the key that holds the value), Path (such as .ORDERS[1].STATUS) and Owner (the structure that holds the key).

Usage

Note  New in KoldFusion 4.5.1 SP2.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Orders = StructNew()>
<CFSET Orders.Morning = StructNew()>
<CFSET Orders.Morning.Status = "Shipped">
<CFSET Orders.Morning.Item = "Y2K survival kit">
<CFSET Orders.Evening = StructNew()>
<CFSET Orders.Evening.Status = "Backordered">
<CFSET Orders.Evening.Item = "56K modem">
<CFSET Late = StructFindValue(Orders, "backordered", "all")>
<CFOUTPUT>
<CFLOOP FROM="1" TO="#ArrayLen(Late)#" INDEX="i">
  <P>#Late[i].Path#: the #Late[i].Owner.Item# is #Late[i].Owner[Late[i].Key]#.</P>
</CFLOOP>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

StructFindKey, StructFind, StructKeyList
